google_adk.evidence: mcp-mirror scan --runner managed --frameworks google_adk --spec-version 2026-07-28 (google-adk[mcp] 2.11.0, mcp 2.0.0) exited 3: the direct source connection negotiated 2026-07-28 through server/discover, while McpToolset's ClientSession.initialize returned protocolVersion 2025-11-25. By default ADK's MCPSessionManager opens every session with the legacy initialize handshake, so the adapter cannot reach a 2026-07-28 session. With the documented opt-in ADK_ENABLE_MCP_MODERN_PROTOCOL=1, 2.11.0 calls the SDK's negotiate_auto instead: the client sent server/discover, negotiated 2026-07-28, and reached tools/list on stdio and HTTP (data/specs/2026-07-28/measurements/opt-in/google_adk-modern-protocol/protocol/google_adk/stdio-00.jsonl, http.jsonl). The renderer reads the adopted version from ClientSession.adopt, which both the default initialize handshake and negotiate_auto end in, so the opt-in scan completes (data/specs/2026-07-28/measurements/opt-in/google_adk-modern-protocol/scan.json: status measured, negotiated 2026-07-28 through server/discover). No cell comes from the opt-in run; the default handshake still decides the row.
